GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 6l off, limited room turn, Straightened Up well off held up, off heels 200m, hit line well late once clear # margin unfair
Jumped Ok , led rails 800m, gave kick and looked home at 200m, started to feel the pinch late and was claimed final couple of strides # led/nabbed late

Jumped Well from a low draw. pressed on led on rail x half length @ 800m. Same Straightening Up asked to extend. did so. claimed by $1.85 winner within 100m, went to line Clear 2nd # led/solid in defeat

Jumped okay & Went Forward to 1 length Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led 0.75 Lengths turning, Headed 200m and Lost Ground to the line. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. App. jockey stated it led with minimal pressure however refused to settle and worked hard within itself early/middle stages. She stated it sprinted fairly on straightening however peaked on its run passing 100m and weakened to the line. Trainer stated it was freshened up for the run and it appears, at this stage of its preparation 1300m proved too taxing and she would drop it back in distance next start. Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality.] # weak once headed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: App stated mount led under minimal pressure however refused to settle, working hard within itself in e&m stages. App stated mount sprinted fairly on straightening however peaked on run passing 100m & weakened to line. App stated mount's racing manners in e&m stages were to detriment of finishing effort. Tnr stated mare freshened up for todays event & it appears 1300m was too taxing at this stage of prep. Tnr to drop back in dist next start. P/R vet no ab's.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 900m raced keenly when being steadied to obtain cover.

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing a head, held together much same to turn 1 length Two Wide , hit Lead 160m and kept going to post # bolted in
Jumped Ok Went Forward ended up 3rd 2 Lengths . Hard Ridden turning for home, had nothing to offer in Straight # couldn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Buffeted at jumping away between horses. Raced keen in the early stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: reared on jumping away. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event. Raced wide without cover throughout. Laid in under pressure in the straight. Near the 200m shifted in onto another runner. vet lame near fore (2/5)

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat Two Wide Leaders heels 1 Lengths 1000m, loomed to win on the corner but under riding, run ended last 200m and weakened # on pace/tired 200m
